name: Vili’s Health Bar
notes: Own site (Weebly) links a 6-page priced PDF menu ('Vili's Health Bar Menu (5)') pulled directly with curl and read via pdftotext -layout - no browser needed. Full section coverage: Basics (drip/espresso/latte coffees), Bullet Coffee (14 variants), Smoothies (10), Superfood Smoothie Bowls (5), Organic Loose Leaf Tea (flat $3.50, no per-flavor price so tea flavors omitted). Note: the PDF and the site's own footer both list the address as 4861 Newport Avenue, Ocean Beach, but the work-list address is 1780 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. WebSearch (Yelp, Waze, DoorDash, TripTap) confirms 1780 Sunset Cliffs Blvd as the current, correct address for this exact business name/phone-area; the website's address appears stale. Same unique brand (organic bullet coffee + vegan superfood desserts in Ocean Beach), so treated as the same restaurant despite the site's outdated address line.

name: Coco Bomb
notes: Own site (cocobombusa.com) embeds a Toast ordering widget with a full server-rendered priced menu in window.__OO_STATE__ - pulled with curl (Chrome UA) and parsed as JSON, no browser needed. 39 dishes across 4 sections (Coffee, Special Drinks, Ice Cream, Thai Desserts) - matches the concept described on the homepage. Division test against 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 found no dominant clean multiplier, consistent with real menu pricing rather than marketplace markup. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the only working ordering page found is for the Convoy Street location; the work-list address is 2379 Ulric Street (the 'Linda Vista' location the homepage itself describes as the original store). No separate Ulric St. ordering page/menu guid could be found on the site - the site's Apollo cache only contains the Convoy location. Since this is the same single brand/menu (small dessert-drink concept, standardized pricing) rather than a different restaurant, the Convoy menu is used as the best available source for this listing, but a genuinely Ulric-St-specific price list was not confirmed.

name: Sammy's Woodfried Pizza
blocked: needs a browser - sammyspizza.com serves a Cloudflare bot-challenge (403, Cf-Mitigated: challenge) to a plain curl even with a real Chrome UA string, so the own site is unreadable without a JS-capable browser. The only alternate priced source found (DoorDash, doordash.com/store/sammy's-woodfired-pizza-and-grill-san-marcos-85855) is disqualified: 82 of 84 items divide cleanly by 1.10 onto round dollar/half-dollar values (e.g. $24.20->$22.00, $33.00->$30.00, $11.00->$10.00) - a textbook uniform delivery-marketplace markup, not the restaurant's real pricing. order.online for the same restaurant would be the same DoorDash ownership and can't corroborate independently.
notes: Address (121 S Las Posas Rd, San Marcos) confirmed correct via search. Sections seen on DoorDash (Most Ordered, Soup, Shareables, Salads, Entrees, Pastas, Tacos, Pizzas, Kid's Menu, Desserts) look like full menu shape, but every price on that source is disqualified by the markup test.

name: Tilted Stick
blocked: needs a browser - the restaurant's own ordering site (tiltedstick.online, ChowNow-style) returns 403 Forbidden to a plain curl even with a Chrome UA (generic nginx/proxy WAF block, not a Cloudflare challenge page but same effect). Grubhub (grubhub.com/restaurant/tilted-stick-bar-and-grill-4970-voltaire-st-san-diego/279472) and allmenus.com both return small JS-shell pages with zero priced items in the raw HTML - both need client-side rendering.
notes: Address (4970 Voltaire St) confirmed via search - matches The Tilted Stick Bar & Grill, Ocean Beach dive bar. A WebSearch snippet surfaced a few unverified prices (Original Stick Salad $8, Burger $12, Bacon Cheez Burger $15.50, Grilled Chicken Sandwich $16.25) but these could not be confirmed against literal page bytes from any fetchable source, so they were not recorded per the WebFetch/summary safety rule.

name: Santa Anna Mexican Food
notes: No own website. Matched by exact address (4909 El Cajon Blvd) to 'Santa Ana Fresh Mexican Food' on DoorDash (name spelling varies Santa Ana/Santa Anna across sources but address and phone match). Full schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD pulled via curl, 91 dishes across 10 sections (Most Ordered, Tortas, Breakfast Tortas, Burritos, Breakfast Burritos, Fries & Chips, Quesadillas, Tacos, Seafood, Combination Plate). Division test found no dominant clean multiplier (max 9/91 hits at 1.25) and prices are predominantly .99-ending (loss-leader/POS style, e.g. Bean & Cheese Burrito $7.99, TJ Taco $3.50), consistent with real till pricing rather than delivery markup. Could not reach a working Uber Eats listing to cross-check (404) given time budget; recorded at tier-3 medium per the ladder since it's a single delivery source that passes the markup test.

name: Pacific Pizza
blocked: needs a browser - pacificpizza.net's menu runs on Popmenu. The page's schema.org JSON-LD (server-rendered) covers only the currently-active 'Pizza' menu tab and is itself incomplete: 'Build Your Own Hand-Tossed Pizza' (3 sizes, $14/$16/$18) and 'Pizza By The Slice' ($4) and one 'Deals & Combos' item ($7) have real prices, but the core 'Specialty Pizzas' section (11 named pizzas - San Diegan, Carne, Pesto, Greek Chicken, Margarita, BBQ Chicken, Ranch Chicken, Buffalo Chicken, Veggie, Espinacas, Blanco, Hawaiian) has NO price field at all on any item, server-side or on the individual item pages. Confirmed this is Popmenu's known client-fetch limitation (only 12 MenuItem objects are SSR'd; the site references other menus too - Salads, Pasta, Calzones & Stromboli, Desserts, Beverages - none of which rendered any items or prices server-side). Address (14897 Pomerado Rd, Poway) confirmed correct via the page's own location=poway-ca parameter.
notes: A pizzeria missing prices on its entire named-pizza lineup is a core-section gap, not an adjunct one - would mislead a diner about what the specialty pizzas cost, so withheld rather than submitted as a partial.

name: Tacos El Gallo
notes: No own website (Instagram only). Matched by exact address (569 N 2nd St, El Cajon) via search. Full schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD pulled via curl, 37 distinct dishes across 3 sections (Most Ordered/Tacos El Gallo/Drinks - the first two overlap almost entirely so treated as one taco-shop menu). Division test against 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3 found no dominant clean multiplier among the 15 distinct prices, so no clear delivery-markup signature. Could not reach a working Uber Eats page to cross-check within time budget (redirect issue). Recorded medium per the ladder (single delivery source, passes markup test).

name: Shiraz Persian Cuisine
notes: Own site's food-menu page renders a full priced HTML menu server-side via its SpotOn ordering embed (tmt.spotapps.co) - no browser needed. 61 dishes across 8 sections (Appetizers & Sides, Persian Kababs, Rice Specialties, Persian Stews, Soups & Salads, Traditional Persian Specialties, Desserts & Persian Drinks, Lunch). IMPORTANT: division test found 39 of 61 prices (64%) divide cleanly by 1.04 onto .99/.00-ending base values (e.g. Hummus $10.39 -> $9.99, Koobideh Kabab $25.99 -> $24.99) - matching the known 'own-platform online-ordering surcharge' pattern (Cotijas precedent), not a marketplace markup. No unsurcharged dine-in/PDF menu was found elsewhere on the site to re-extract from. Prices are recorded AS DISPLAYED on the restaurant's own ordering page (not algebraically 'corrected'), since this is a small, disclosed first-party fee rather than third-party inflation, but the surcharge should be kept in mind.

name: Scoreboard Ii
blocked: needs a browser - no website, no DoorDash/Grubhub/UberEats listing found for this location despite searching. The only priced source found (sandiegoreader.com/places/scoreboard/) lists a quarter-pound burger at $2.99 and spaghetti with meatballs at $6.99 with no publish date visible on the page - these price levels are implausibly low for current pricing (archaeological, San Diego Reader place pages are known to go years without updates) and were rejected on the price-level staleness test. Yelp's menu tab is barred and its dated-photo tab requires a browser to page through the virtualized carousel.
notes: Work-list address (715 Palm Avenue) does not match the address on any source found (951 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach) - confirmed via multiple independent sources (Tripadvisor, Yelp, Facebook, sandiegoreader) that 'Scoreboard II' / 'The Scoreboard IB' sports bar sits at 951 Palm Ave, a second location of the original 16th St. Scoreboard. Given the exact, distinctive name match ('Scoreboard II') this is treated as the same restaurant with a stale/incorrect OSM address, not a different business.

name: Sro Lounge
notes: No website, no DoorDash/Grubhub/UberEats listing. Every search result besides Yelp (barred) is a directory-farm/fabricated-listing page (weeblyte.com, placejoys.com, foodjoyy.com, restaurants-info.com) with no genuine per-item prices - restaurantguru.com's own menu page loaded but contained zero prices. This is a gay bar/lounge with informal food (a Friday chicken buffet mentioned in reviews) and no evidence anywhere of a published per-item priced menu. Recorded not_found rather than blocked since no priced source appears to exist at all, not merely one that needs a browser.

name: Society
blocked: needs a browser - own site (societypb.com/our-menus) links a current (dated 2026-05, filename 'rev47') dinner menu PDF that uses a copy-protected/substituted font: pdftotext extracts dish names as scrambled character-substitution garbage (readable prose/description text stays intact, but bolded item names and many prices are unreadable as text) - needs visual/OCR reading, which this no-browser pass cannot do. The one FULLY readable priced source, the restaurant's Toast ordering page (order.toasttab.com/online/society-pb-1051-garnet-ave), is itself explicitly labeled 'Society/Bubba's Menu 3PO Online Only' in its own Toast metadata - '3PO' being the confirmed third-party-ordering-fee marker from prior findings. Spot-checked against legible price fragments in the protected PDF: Chili Fries $18 (PDF) vs $20 (Toast 3PO), Chicken Strips & Fries $20 vs $22, Wings Rings & Things $32 vs $40 - a real 10-25% markup, confirming the 3PO menu should not be used.
notes: An older PDF (Dinner-Menu-04-13-2022-Revised.pdf) is cleanly readable but describes a completely different menu concept (Shareables/Tacos/Mixed Dip Plate) with no overlap with the current 'Bubba's BBQ' concept referenced on both the current PDF and the Toast page - rejected as stale/wrong-lineup rather than used.

name: Poncho's Mexican & Sea Food
notes: Own site (ponchosmexicanfoodca.com) has no public menu page - ordering is only through a native app (Apple/Google Play, smarterswipe.com backend), which is not readable without a browser/app. Matched by exact name and address (1279 E Main St, El Cajon) to a DoorDash listing. Full schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD pulled via curl, 91 dishes across 13 sections (Most Ordered, Extra/add-ons, Seafood Plates, Seafood Cocktails, Protein Bowls, Kids Plates, Drinks, Sides, Quesadillas, Tortas, Tostadas, Soups, Combination Plates) - full section coverage for a Mexican & seafood menu including seafood plates/cocktails matching the restaurant's name. Division test found no dominant clean multiplier (best case 10/41 distinct prices near-divide by 1.25, not a strong signal); prices carry unusual non-round, non-.99 cents throughout which is unusual but not diagnostic of a specific known markup pattern - recorded at medium (tier-3 delivery source, ladder default) with this caveat noted. NOTE: be careful not to confuse this with the separate/different-named 'Pancho's Mexican Restaurant' (panchosatelcajon.com) or the differently-branded 'Ponchos Taco Shop' DoorDash listing at a similar area - this entry is specifically 'Ponchos Mexican and Seafood - EL CAJON on Main St' at the exact matching address.
